title.zh: 【Jack Henry 将接入 Google Cloud Universal Ledger，为美国银行及信用社提供代币化存款服务】
title.en: 【Jack Henry 将接入 Google Cloud Universal Ledger，为美国银行及信用社提供代币化存款服务】

current_state.zh: Jack Henry is expanding its Google Cloud partnership to connect US banks and credit unions to Google Cloud Universal Ledger, enabling tokenized deposits and programmable 24/7 settlement on a shared ledger.
current_state.en: Jack Henry is expanding its Google Cloud partnership to connect US banks and credit unions to Google Cloud Universal Ledger, enabling tokenized deposits and programmable 24/7 settlement on a shared ledger.
